moves.name: Acid Spray
moves.description: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Acrobatics
moves.description: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.

moves.name: Acupressure
moves.description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.description: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.description: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Aqua Ring
moves.description: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

moves.name: Aqua Tail
moves.description: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Avalanche
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

moves.name: Axe Kick
moves.description: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Beat Up
moves.description: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.description: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.

moves.name: Bind
moves.description: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Blast Burn
moves.description: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.description: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Block
moves.description: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.description: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.description: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Breaking Swipe
moves.description: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Brutal Swing
moves.description: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

moves.name: Bug Bite
moves.description: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

moves.name: Bug Buzz
moves.description: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.description: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.description: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Charm
moves.description: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.description: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Circle Throw
moves.description: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: Lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stage after dealing damage.

moves.name: Coaching
moves.description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Cross Poison
moves.description: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.

moves.name: Detect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Dive
moves.description: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.description: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.

moves.name: Dragon Cheer
moves.description: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.description: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.description: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

moves.name: Dragon Pulse
moves.description: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

moves.name: Dragon Rush
moves.description: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Dragon Tail
moves.description: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Drill Run
moves.description: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.description: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.description: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: Deals double damage to underground targets and half damage during Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Electroweb
moves.description: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description: The target must use its last successfully used move for the next 3 turns. Encore fails if the target has no valid last move or if its last move cannot be encored (such as Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform). It also fails if the move has no remaining PP.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.description: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.description: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.description: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Feint
moves.description: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.

moves.name: Fell Stinger
moves.description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat is boosted drastically.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.description: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Fire Fang
moves.description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.description: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

moves.name: Flail
moves.description: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Flame Charge
moves.description: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.description: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws the user if frozen. The user takes recoil damage equal to 1/3 of the damage dealt.

moves.name: Flash Cannon
moves.description: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Flatter
moves.description: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Fly
moves.description: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

moves.name: Frenzy Plant
moves.description: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.description: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Grassy Terrain
moves.description: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

moves.name: Gravity
moves.description: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.description: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Hard Press
moves.description: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Haze
moves.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.name: Head Smash
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.

moves.name: Heal Pulse
moves.description: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.name: Heat Crash
moves.description: The user slams into the target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.description: Has a 10% chance to burn targets.

moves.name: Heavy Slam
moves.description: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Hex
moves.description: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: High Jump Kick
moves.description: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

moves.name: Howl
moves.description: The user howls loudly to rouse itself and its allies. This boosts their Attack stats.

moves.name: Hurricane
moves.description: Has a 30% chance of confusing the target. In rain, this move never misses. In harsh sunlight, this move's accuracy is 50%. This move can hit a target that has the Sky-High status.

moves.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.description: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.description: The user attacks by letting loose a horribly loud, resounding cry.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Ice Fang
moves.description: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Ice Spinner
moves.description: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.name: Inferno
moves.description: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.description: The user lays roots that restore its own HP every turn. Because the user is now rooted, it can't switch out.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.description: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

moves.name: Iron Head
moves.description: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

moves.name: Lava Plume
moves.description: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.description: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and cuts the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Leaf Storm
moves.description: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.description: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

moves.name: Life Dew
moves.description: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description: Halves damage from special moves for the user’s side for 5 turns.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Low Sweep
moves.description: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.description: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Magnet Rise
moves.description: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.description: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.description: The user gathers energy from space and boosts its Sp. Atk stat on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.description: A retaliatory attack that counters any special move, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Misty Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.description: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.description: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the target with all its might. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.description: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.name: Petal Blizzard
moves.description: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.description: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.description: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting sharp spikes at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: Poisons the target. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.

moves.name: Pollen Puff
moves.description: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

moves.name: Pounce
moves.description: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

moves.name: Power Trick
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: Protects the user from most targeted moves for the turn. Each consecutive use has a 1/3 chance of succeeding.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Psychic Fangs
moves.description: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.description: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.description: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.description: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Quick Guard
moves.description: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: Summons rain for 5 turns, boosting Water-type moves by 50% and reducing Fire-type moves by 50%.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.description: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Roar
moves.description: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Rock Polish
moves.description: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Hurls large boulders at the targets. Has a 30% chance to make them flinch.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

moves.name: Roost
moves.description: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.

moves.name: Round
moves.description: The user attacks with a song. If an ally also uses Round this turn, they act immediately after the first user, and each consecutive Round doubles in power, up to 240.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.description: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.description: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.

moves.name: Scale Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.description: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.description: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: Has a 20% chance to lower the target’s Sp. Def by 1 stage.

moves.name: Shadow Claw
moves.description: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Shell Smash
moves.description: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

moves.name: Sing
moves.description: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.description: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.description: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: Puts the target to sleep. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.description: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Snarl
moves.description: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Snowscape
moves.description: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: Charges before attacking, unless harsh sunlight is active. During rain, it requires an extra charge turn and its power is halved. Power is also halved during snow and sandstorm.

moves.name: Solar Blade
moves.description: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.description: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Stealth Rock
moves.description: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.description: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.description: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.description: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.

moves.name: Stomping Tantrum
moves.description: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.description: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.description: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Struggle Bug
moves.description: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user loses 1/4 of its max HP to create a substitute. The substitute will be hit by moves instead of the user, and it will vanish when it takes damage equal to 1/4 of the user's max HP. Sound-based moves will hit the user through the substitute.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns, boosting Fire-type moves by 50% and reducing Water-type moves by 50%.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.description: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.description: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Tailwind
moves.description: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that doubles the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Temper Flare
moves.description: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.description: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

moves.name: Thunder Fang
moves.description: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Trailblaze
moves.description: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Trick
moves.description: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.

moves.name: Trick Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Upper Hand
moves.description: Makes the target flinch. This move fails if the target isn't about to use a priority attack.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.description: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.description: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

moves.name: Wave Crash
moves.description: The user takes recoil equal to 1/3 of the damage dealt.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.description: Changes type based on the weather. In harsh sunlight it becomes Fire, rain Water, snow Ice, and sandstorm Rock. Power doubles while weather is active.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.description: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.description: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

moves.name: Wonder Room
moves.description: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.description: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

moves.name: X-Scissor
moves.description: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.description: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

abilities.name: Anger Point
abilities.description: The Pokémon is angered when it takes a critical hit, and that maxes its Attack stat.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: Powers up Fire-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.description: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Flash Fire
abilities.description: If hit by a Fire-type move, the Pokémon absorbs the flames and uses them to power up its own Fire-type moves.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.description: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.description: The power of punching moves is increased by 20%. This stacks with

abilities.name: Leaf Guard

abilities.name: Light Metal
abilities.description: Halves the Pokémon's weight.

abilities.name: Liquid Voice
abilities.description: Sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

abilities.name: Long Reach
abilities.description: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.

abilities.name: Magma Armor
abilities.description: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.

abilities.name: Moxie
abilities.description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.

abilities.name: Overgrow
abilities.description: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.description: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

abilities.name: Rock Head
abilities.description: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

abilities.name: Sheer Force
abilities.description: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.

abilities.name: Sniper
abilities.description: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.

abilities.name: Solar Power
abilities.description: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.

abilities.name: Solid Rock
abilities.description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.description: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.description: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.description: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.

abilities.name: Telepathy
abilities.description: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.description: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
